_suffix: Vertical 9:16, Pixar-style cinematic 3D. Keep the SAME characters, faces, outfits, place and lighting as the attached scene. Cico's round white "26" badge only on his LEFT upper arm. If someone looks at a phone we see only its BACK and the glow on the face. No readable text, no logos, no Maiden's Tower.

items.p: Aftermath of choosing 'Sign, leave it, go': at the same school entrance, Cico has set the unmarked box down on the step and signs the paper Filiz holds out; he pulls up his hood and turns to leave. Filiz stands with arms crossed, cold look. In a classroom window behind, the kid in the red hoodie watches.

Aftermath of choosing 'Let's open it together': Cico and Filiz kneel by the classroom door with the box on the floor, cutting the tape together; the flap opens a little, Filiz curious, Cico holding small scissors.

Aftermath of choosing 'Show the list': Cico holds his phone out toward Filiz (screen facing her, we see its back); Filiz leans in, the screen light on her face, and for the first time she looks at Cico with trust.

Aftermath of hesitating too long: Cico stands frozen at the school door still hugging the box, looking down at his phone (we see its back); a cold green glow on his face as the app marks the delivery done without him. Filiz is already turning away.

Aftermath of choosing 'Take the box back': Cico walks out of the school gate hugging the box, his phone in the other hand glowing red on his face (account suspended). Behind him in the yard Filiz smiles softly.

Aftermath of choosing 'Leave it, we'll talk later': Cico sets the box down by the classroom door and walks away quickly; Filiz looks from the box to his back. A small green coin glow on his phone in his pocket.

Aftermath of hesitating: Cico stares at his phone (we see its back) as a green confirmation glow lights his face; the box stays exactly where it was in the school yard, children playing in soft focus.
Aftermath of choosing 'Tell him': in the dim corner of the coffee house Cico leans toward Endurocu, whispering. Endurocu stirs his tea and smiles; under the table his phone glows faintly, recording.
Aftermath of choosing 'Brush it off': Cico shrugs and sips his tea, looking away. Endurocu grins, but his eyes narrow.
Aftermath of choosing 'Ask the Chief': Cico has turned toward the Chief's table. The Chief raises an eyebrow and gives Endurocu a sideways look; Endurocu's smile freezes.
Aftermath of choosing 'Accept': Cico reaches toward the black car's open window and the Man hands him a sealed plain envelope. Cico's eyes are on the ground.
Aftermath of choosing 'Refuse': Cico shakes his head and pushes the envelope back. The car window slowly rises, the Man's look hardening behind the glass.
Aftermath of choosing 'Pretend to accept': Cico smiles and shakes the Man's hand; his other hand is inside his jacket, where a tiny red recording light glows from his phone.

Aftermath of choosing 'Delete the children's records': night, the ROTA office. Cico alone at the desk, his finger over the mouse; the monitor shows a list of rows with a big red trash-can icon highlighted (no text). Through the window, the silhouette of the school.
Aftermath of hesitating: Cico stands frozen. The Man glances at his watch, nods slowly as if a decision was made, and the black car glides away.
Aftermath of choosing 'Tell her everything': on the school steps Cico talks earnestly; Filiz has her hand over her mouth. Far down the street, the silhouette of the black car.
Aftermath of choosing 'Just listen': Filiz talks, Cico sits quietly beside her listening; two paper tea cups on the step between them.
Aftermath of choosing 'I have to go': Cico stands up from the step with his scooter key in hand; Filiz stays seated, watching him leave.
Aftermath of choosing 'Put it in the locker': Cico slides the parcel into the open locker compartment, the screen glows green with a check-mark icon. At the door Filiz looks hurt.
Aftermath of choosing 'Warn Filiz without putting it in': Cico, parcel still in his arms, leans toward Filiz explaining quietly; the locker screen behind them glows red with a waiting hourglass icon.

Aftermath of choosing 'Photograph the screen and camera': Cico holds his phone up photographing the locker's screen and camera lens (we see the back of his phone); the camera's red light turns toward him.
Aftermath of hesitating: the locker compartment closes by itself with the parcel inside; Cico's hands are left empty in the air, surprised.

Aftermath of choosing 'Take it': under the bridge Cico takes the stack of banknotes and puts it into the strike fund tin; the tribe nods, Endurocu grins. A tiny tracking tag on the money band glints in the low light.
Aftermath of choosing 'Refuse': Cico pushes the money back with his palm. Endurocu's face tightens; the couriers exchange looks.
Aftermath of choosing 'Ask about his past': Cico looks Endurocu straight in the eye; behind them the Chief frowns. Endurocu answers but his eyes slide away.
Aftermath of choosing 'Open up': Cico and Filiz side by side on the school steps at night; Cico talks and Filiz smiles warmly for the first time.
Aftermath of choosing 'Listen': Filiz talks with her hands, Cico listens closely; the street lamps flicker on behind them.
Aftermath of choosing 'Keep your distance': Cico stands on the bottom step, Filiz sits at the top; the distance between them is clear and quiet.
Aftermath of choosing 'Confess you are the mole': Cico shows Filiz the cheap black second phone in his open palm. Filiz does not pull back, but her eyes fill with tears.
Aftermath of choosing 'Follow him': Cico on his green scooter with its headlight off, watching from a distance as Endurocu's big grey bike pulls away down the wet street between street lamps.

Aftermath of choosing 'Tell the Chief': Cico whispers into his phone held to his ear in the shadows; behind him, by the print house door, Endurocu turns his head toward him with a phone at his own ear.

Aftermath of choosing 'Confess: expose Endurocu and yourself': Cico in the dark typing on his phone (we see its back), jaw clenched, his face lit; his thumb hovering, then pressing send — a small green glow.
Aftermath of choosing 'Write the plan to the Man': Cico alone against a wall, the second black phone in his hand (we see its back) glowing; he closes his eyes as the message goes.
Aftermath of hesitating: while Cico hesitates at the corner, Endurocu turns on the street and sees him through the visor of his helmet.
